Smile Design

Full smile blueprints with Digital Smile Design (DSD). We turn intraoral scans into a digital mock-up and a wearable veneer mock-up, so your patient can see and try the result before any treatment begins.

Download RX forms

What we make

  • Digital mock-upAn on-screen preview of the planned smile.
  • Wearable mock-upVeneer mock-up the patient can try in.

How it works

  1. SendScan, impressions or drop-off, with a completed RX form.
  2. DesignPlanned and designed in CAD/CAM to your prescription.
  3. MakeMade in the lab, then finished and checked by hand.
  4. ReturnBack to your clinic by track-and-trace courier or drop-off.

What to send us

  • Intraoral scans of both arches
  • Full-face and retracted smile photos
  • Your patient’s goals and any constraints

Questions

What is a wearable mock-up?

A thin veneer mock-up made from the digital design that your patient can try in, so they can see and feel the planned smile before committing to treatment.

What do you need from us?

Intraoral scans, a set of facial and smile photos, and a note on what your patient wants to change.

Which scanners work?

Scans from 3Shape TRIOS, iTero and Medit are all accepted.

Other services

  • Crown & BridgeSingle crowns to multi-unit bridges, designed from your scan and finished by hand at the bench.
  • Implant RestorationsCustom abutments and implant crowns, from a single tooth through to full-arch.
  • All-on-4 & All-on-6Full-arch implant prostheses on four or six implants.
  • Orthodontic AppliancesRetainers, night guards and clear aligners, made to your prescription.
  • Surgical GuidesGuides that transfer your implant plan to the mouth for more predictable placement.
